Get ministries

Source: R/query-tables.R
get_ministries.Rd

Reads the ministries table: one row per ministry and governing party. Which ministry governed in a period.

Usage

get_ministries(
  MinistryNumber = NULL,
  MinistryName = NULL,
  DateStart = NULL,
  DateEnd = NULL,
  Party = NULL,
  pID = NULL,
  party_id = NULL,
  ...,
  active_during = NULL,
  columns = NULL,
  collect = TRUE,
  limit = NULL
)

Arguments

MinistryNumber

Filter on column MinistryNumber (INTEGER).

MinistryName

Filter on column MinistryName (VARCHAR).

DateStart

Filter on column DateStart (DATE).

DateEnd

Filter on column DateEnd (DATE).

Party

Filter on column Party (VARCHAR).

pID

Filter on column pID (DOUBLE).

party_id

Filter on column party_id (INTEGER).

...

Must be empty. It forces the arguments after it to be named.

active_during

Keep rows whose period overlaps this: a year, a date (Date or "YYYY-MM-DD"), or an in_range() of years or dates. The period runs from DateStart to DateEnd; a missing DateEnd means it is ongoing. NULL (the default) applies no date filter.

columns

Character vector of columns to return; NULL returns all.

collect

If TRUE (the default), return a tibble; if FALSE, a lazy table for further dplyr work.

limit

Maximum number of rows to return, or NULL for no limit.

Value

A tibble with one row per ministry and governing party and every column of ministries (zero rows if nothing matches), or a lazy table if collect = FALSE.

Details

Every column except content and *_raw columns is a filter argument, spelt as in the database. Each takes NULL (no filter, the default), a vector of values to match, in_range() for an inclusive range, or matches_pattern() for a case-insensitive pattern. Filters combine with AND. Stored values are returned unchanged, and no other filter is applied.

Generated from the database catalog by data-raw/generate-getters.R; for tables without a getter use db_tbl().

See also

in_range(), matches_pattern(), db_tbl()

Examples

db_connect(sample = TRUE)
get_ministries(active_during = 1975)
#> # A tibble: 5 × 7
#>   MinistryNumber MinistryName         DateStart  DateEnd    Party   pID party_id
#>            <int> <chr>                <date>     <date>     <chr> <dbl>    <int>
#> 1             50 Whitlam Ministry (2… 1974-05-18 1975-11-11 Aust…     1        1
#> 2             51 Fraser Ministry      1975-11-11 1975-12-13 Libe…     4        4
#> 3             51 Fraser Ministry      1975-11-11 1975-12-13 Nati…    43       43
#> 4             52 Fraser Ministry (2n… 1975-12-13 1977-12-10 Libe…     4        4
#> 5             52 Fraser Ministry (2n… 1975-12-13 1977-12-10 Nati…    43       43
db_disconnect()
